verdict.rationale: Lindy is itself an AI assistant, and its docs describe delegating work to it directly: in Slack DMs (email, meetings, scheduling), over iMessage/SMS ("delegate to your AI assistant right from your phone"), and as ad-hoc research tasks. Delegation goes further with routines that run on autopilot, auto-invoked skills, and inbox drafting gated by guardrails and approval. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as documented, since all evidence is vendor documentation.
